ABOUT.SUBTITLE: WHO'S DANIEL?
ABOUT.TITLE: About Me
ABOUT.TEXT1: Hey there, I'm Daniel. I'm a passionate developer who loves creating innovative solutions. My journey in web development started about 3 years ago. My goal is to keep learning and growing into a professional in this field.
ABOUT.TEXT2: Let's collaborate and build something remarkable together!

SKILLS.DESCRIPTION: Here you can find an overview of the technologies and tools I have experience with. I am always eager to learn new skills and expand my knowledge in the field of web development.

PROJECTS.DESCRIPTION: Here are some of my recent projects. I used the technologies listed above this section. It also includes the Join project, which I built together with other Developer Akademie participants.

JOIN.TITLE: Join
JOIN.TEXT: Task manager inspired by the Kanban system. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functionality, assign users and categories.

SHARKIE.TEXT: A fun shark-themed game where players navigate through the ocean to collect treasures and defeat the endboss.

POKEDEX.TEXT: A comprehensive database of all Pokémon species, featuring detailed information, stats, and evolutionary chains.

C1.TEXT: Daniel is a highly driven colleague who is not afraid of challenges and consistently leads by example. With his proactive mindset, he motivates the team and drives projects to success.

C2.TEXT: Daniel is a reliable and solution-oriented team member. He independently took on tasks and solved them quickly and efficiently, making a valuable contribution to the team.

CONTACT.SUBTITLE: CONTACT ME
CONTACT.TITLE: Ready to work together?
CONTACT.TEXT:
I’m always excited to connect with new people and explore opportunities where I can contribute my skills as a Frontend Developer. If you’re looking for someone who is passionate about creating clean, user-friendly interfaces and continuously improving their craft, I’d love to hear from you.

I’m particularly interested in joining a team where I can grow, take on new challenges, and actively contribute to meaningful projects. With a strong foundation in modern web technologies and a constant drive to learn, I’m confident that I can add value while evolving alongside your team.

Feel free to reach out — I’m always open to discussing new ideas, collaborations, or opportunities.

PRIVACY.PRIVACY_TEXT_1: This website is operated as a personal portfolio. Protecting your personal data is very important to me. This privacy policy explains what data is collected and how it is used.
PRIVACY.PRIVACY_TEXT_2: When visiting this website, basic technical information such as your browser type, operating system, and access time may be automatically collected. This data is used solely to ensure the proper functioning and security of the website.
PRIVACY.PRIVACY_TEXT_3: If you contact me via the contact form, the information you provide (such as your name, email address, and message) will be used solely for the purpose of processing your request. This data will not be shared with third parties.
PRIVACY.PRIVACY_TEXT_4: This website is hosted using Firebase Hosting. The hosting provider may collect and store server log files, which include information such as IP addresses and access times. These logs are used for security and technical purposes.
PRIVACY.PRIVACY_TEXT_5: You have the right to request information about your stored data, as well as the correction or deletion of your data. If you have any questions regarding your data, you can contact me at any time.
